subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映水兰香
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澹泊寧静度河橋而西為映水蘭香西向五楹東南為釣魚磯北為印月池池北為知耕織又北稍東為濯鱗沼映水蘭香西南為貴織山堂祀蠶神（圓明園册）臣等謹按映水蘭香四十景之一額為皇上御書釣魚磯印月池知耕織濯鱗沼貴織山堂諸額皆世宗御書
evidence.summary: West across the stream: 映水蘭香, five bays facing west, with the 釣魚磯, 印月池, 知耕織, 濯鱗沼 and 貴織山堂, a shrine to the silkworm spirit.

evidence.title: 印月池
evidence.locator: v2 p.189, under 映水兰香
evidence.excerpt_zh: 一月千川，宁独此一池然？一池之月，即千川之月也，朅尔静悟，不异当时指月佛诠。穿池贮净水，孤月喜居之。秋夕寥萧际，春宵澹荡时。一将千岂别，半与满无私。金口说如是，瞠乎讵易窥。
evidence.summary: Poem 印月池 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 映水兰香.

evidence.title: 印月池
evidence.locator: v2 p.194, under 映水兰香
evidence.excerpt_zh: 水亦为池冰亦池，月轮印岂择乎斯。不波翻觉澄端正，却似枯禅入定时。
evidence.summary: Poem 印月池 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 映水兰香.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 印月池.
